{{Quote|Let my droids board your little ship to sweep for ''intruders''&mdash;and we'll take care of that troublesome ''shuttle'', too!|[[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]], to [[Jorm]]|<ref name="Starcrusher" />}}
The '''T-6 shuttle''', also known as the '''Jedi ambassador shuttle''', was a semicircular [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] and in use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Adorned with a [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundel]] and painted in the red-and-white [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], T-6 shuttles featured rotating [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpits]] and [[Engine/Legends|engine]] blocks, and were [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped. Several craft of this model were utilized by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] throughout the Clone Wars on a variety of missions. It was still in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The ''gyrostabilizing system'' is damaged!|[[Thill]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
[[File:T6Shuttle-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|A T-6 shuttle in landing configuration]]
Manufactured by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] hives of [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]],<ref name="IV" /> the semicircular T-6 [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]<ref name="CotF guide" /> featured a rotating engine block and [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] that oriented with the rest of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] when landed or in flight,<ref name="CotF" /> a trait made possible by shock-resistant gimbals, one of many technological advancements included in the shuttle by its Verpine designers.<ref name="IV" /> In its landing configuration, the ship sat horizontally, supported by a trio of landing gear. The cockpit, somewhat conical in shape, remained aligned with the body of the craft, with the three engines likewise horizontally aligned with the body of the shuttle. When entering flight mode, the cockpit and the engine block rotated ninety degrees. The craft had one loading ramp, located on the port side of the engine block.<ref name="CotF" /> Shuttles of this class featured [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seats]] that, when launched, enclosed the being in a flexible, cushioned [[Survival capsule/Legends|survival capsule]].<ref name="BH" /><ref name="BHguide" /> They also featured [[gyro stabilizer]]s.<ref name="Downhill" />

Due to its role as an ambassadorial craft, the T-6 shuttle lacked weaponry, but was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Furthermore, the craft's spacious interior provided for reasonably comfortable [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel.<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|technology|jedit6shuttle|Jedi T-6 shuttle}}</ref> When pressed into service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] T-6 shuttles were adorned with a [[Republic crest/Legends|Galactic Roundel]] and painted in the red-and-white color scheme of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="CotF guide" /> though they remained unarmed.<ref name="CotF Dataclip" /> They could be equipped with a pair of [[Missile/Legends|Missile]] launchers.<ref name="Downhill" />

==History==
{{Quote|I could fly this thing with ''both'' engines on quarter power, Master...|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
Crafted by the Verpine shipbuilders of the [[Roche system]], T-6 shuttles were designed for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="IV" /> which employed the craft since at least [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The Lost One" /> Their use by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> primarily in times of peace,<ref name="SWE" /> earned them the nickname "Jedi [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] shuttles,"<ref name="Art of TCW" /> although elite [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]] of the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used the craft as well.<ref name="IV" /> A Jedi T-6 was aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] after a [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|battle]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]<ref name="CotF" /> in around 22 BBY.<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Following the [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|capture]] of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], the T-6 shuttle was used to [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|transport]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Bane, and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] to Bane's [[Black Stall Station/Legends|hideout]] in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-strewn [[Rogue Antar system/Legends|Rogue Antar system]] to retrieve a stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. However, the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] proved to be a trap&mdash;Bane eluded his captors and activated the hideout's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]] before departing in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Windu, Kenobi, and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody left in their shuttle with the recovered holocron before the station exploded.<ref name="CotF" />

[[File:T6Shuttle-BH.png|thumb|left|220px|A T-6 shuttle evades Vulture droids above Felucia.]]
Following the destruction of the [[Felucia medical station/Legends|Felucia medical station]], Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Obi-Wan Kenobi, and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] took a T-6 shuttle to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] to [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|investigate]] the [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|medical center's]] disappearance. Upon their arrival, the shuttle was attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] launched from a [[Automated vulture droid deployment station/Legends|deployment pod]]. The [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] shot and disabled the unarmed shuttle, but the trio of Jedi escaped using their ejector seats before the shuttle collided with a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] on the planet's surface.<ref name="BH" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Jedi [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and Ahsoka Tano used a T-6 shuttle to travel to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in search of the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who had taken hostages from the crew of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. The Jedi confronted the renegades on the planet and rescued two of the hostages, capturing Fett and Bossk in the process. The T-6 shuttle was then used to transport the Republic forces and their captives to the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant.<ref name="LT">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> Another T-6 shuttle was used by Padawan Tano and [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] to travel to a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] above [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] during their search for the kidnapped daughters of Pantoran [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]].<ref name="SI">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref> Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker later used a shuttle to journey to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to uncover the origins of a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warrior, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who was responsible for the [[Devaron massacre/Legends|deaths]] of [[Halsey/Legends|two]] [[Knox/Legends|Jedi]]. After learning that Opress was on [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], the duo took the craft to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|confront]] the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|acolyte]]. The shuttle was destroyed by Opress as he made his escape.<ref name="WotM">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>

[[File:T-6Shuttle-CotF.png|thumb|right|220px|A T-6 shuttle docked in the hangar of a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]
A T-6 shuttle was utilized by Jedi [[Jyl Somtay]] to retrieve Skywalker and Kenobi following their successful [[Attack on the Separatist munitions factory|sabotage]] of a [[Separatist munitions factory]]'s [[Force field/Legends|force field]] during the war. A subsequent Republic attack on the factory was thwarted, however, when the Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Starcrusher/Legends|Starcrusher]]'' destroyed the three ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers attacking the facility. Somtay managed to avoid the ''Starcrusher''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the two passengers aboard; she later piloted the T-6 during a Jedi [[Infiltration of the Starcrusher|mission]] to destroy the Separatist warship. Ahsoka Tano, one of the Jedi aboard the T-6, reprogrammed the shuttle to fly toward the ''Starcrusher'' once the Jedi strike team had successfully boarded a [[Tanker/Legends|Separatist refueling ship]]. The empty T-6 shuttle was then destroyed by the ''Starcrusher''{{'s}} batteries as cover for the team's infiltration.<ref name="Starcrusher" />

Skywalker and Tano utilized a T-6 shuttle in their pursuit of bounty hunter [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]&mdash;who was, unbeknownst to them, Obi-Wan Kenobi in disguise&mdash;when Hardeen was implicated in Kenobi's [[Death/Legends|death]], an elaborate ruse conceived by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to uncover a plot to kidnap Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The bounty hunter's trail led to the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], from which Skywalker and Tano followed the disguised Kenobi and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]-for-hire Cad Bane and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] to a [[Orondia station|fueling station]] on nearby [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]]. The two Jedi succeeded in [[Showdown on Orondia/Legends|bringing down]] the bounty hunters' [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] with their T-6 shuttle, though the maneuver forced the shuttle to also crash.<ref name="FaE">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref> A T-6 shuttle later transported Palpatine and several others to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] for the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] celebration, where the kidnapping was attempted.<ref name="CoN">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Kenobi and Plo Koon, along with fellow Jedi [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], [[Grohto]], [[Ko Solok]], and [[Tatsu]], took a T-6 shuttle to the planet [[Orto Norwe]] to investigate a lead on tracking down Savage Opress and his resurrected brother, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who had begun a series of massacres throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="The Sith Hunters">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Downhill Time">"[[Downhill]]" is set after "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]]" ([[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]), as "''[[Mandalorian Memories]]''" serves as a prequel to the episode. Considering that the [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] featured in [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] are published in chronological order, it can be concluded that "''Downhill''" takes place in 20 BBY.</ref> Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone trooper sergeant]] [[Thill]] took an Arquitens and sacrificed it during a [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|mission to Felucia]], using the debris as a cover to infiltrate a [[Felucia Separatist base]] using a T-6 shuttle. The debris knocked down the power to one quarter, meaning they had to crash in the moss. After laying the transmitters, the trio returned to the shuttle with a group of orphaned children, so it did not have enough power to takeoff. Kenobi came up with the idea of using the shuttle to slide down the hill and avoid the impending [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. Skywalker fired missiles at trees in their path, clearing the way. The mission ended with the base destroyed.<ref name="Downhill" />

Later in the war, Skywalker and Tano took a T-6 to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to [[Mission to Malastare (Anakin Skywalker)|investigate]] the disappearance of Master Koon. Tano ended up racing and beating the Separatist sympathizer [[Drez Unlin]]. After arresting him they returned to their shuttle.<ref name="Masked Racer">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>

Skywalker and his droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] took a T-6 shuttle to the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]] where he negotiate [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]'s release. After picking up [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] at his [[Rush Clovis's residence/Legends|residence]], Skywalker contacted R2 to bring the ship to them as their [[Hover sledge/Legends|hover sledge]] was damaged by [[Embo/Legends|Embo]].<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref> The trio flew the T-6 shuttle back to Coruscant with proof of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]'s deception, where [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and several [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]].<ref name="The Rise of Clovis">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref>

The shuttle was still used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had one at the [[Arrochar]] [[Arrochar Rebel base|base]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] piloted it with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to investigate an [[Imperial super hauler]] which had arrived there with a faulty navigation system.<ref name="SW16">[[Star Wars (2013) 16|''Star Wars'' (2013) 16]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|[&hellip;] I ''really'' like this T-6 shuttle. We started to use it quite extensively; I mean, it really has replaced the ''Twilight'', you know, in my eyes.|[[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref>}}
The T-6 shuttle was first seen in a piece of concept art done by Russell Chong and published in ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Art of TCW" /> The ship first appeared in "[[Children of the Force]]," the third episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="CotF" /> The craft went unnamed in the episode but was given the designation "T-6 shuttle" in the accompanying episode guide, which was published on [[StarWars.com]] later the same day.<ref name="CotF guide" /> T-6 shuttles would later appear in several additional episodes of the series.<ref name="BH" /><ref name="LT" /><ref name="SI" /><ref name="WotM" /> The craft also made appearances in two [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] stories, both of which are non-[[canon]]&mdash;the online comic ''[[Jedi Journal Entry #968]]''<ref name="JJE">''[[Jedi Journal Entry #968]]''</ref> and the animated feature [[LEGO Star Wars: The Padawan Menace|''The Padawan Menace'']].<ref name="PM">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Padawan Menace]]''</ref> Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] considers the shuttle, with its [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]&ndash;like cockpit canopy, to be "one of [his] favorite" ships from ''The Clone Wars'', eclipsing the boxy [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 Rigger freighter]] [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] in his opinion.<ref name="Complete Season Two" />

The [http://www.starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep501/#!/media/slideshow online guide] for "[[Revival (episode)|Revival]]," the first episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|''The Clone Wars'': Season Five]], incorrectly identifies an [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]] as a T-6 shuttle.<ref name="Revival guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep501|text="Revival" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
